patch.value: GH-738: publish the machine-readable public SDK surface snapshot with the package

GitHub: https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/738. The shipped SDK documentation directs consumers to tests/fixtures/sdk/public-surface.json, but the npm files allowlist excludes tests. Define a stable published snapshot location/export, package it, update docs, and prove packed consumers can read the exact public surface.
Packed npm and bun consumers can resolve a documented machine-readable public SDK surface artifact; package files and docs agree; public-surface drift gates validate the shipped artifact.
